entities.name: C. elegans ZFP-1
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference P34447 is a 100% identity, 100% query-coverage match to the 768-aa query sequence.
N-terminal region contains PHD/PHD_2 and zf-HC5HC2H zinc-finger Pfam matches spanning approximately residues 8-185.
Functions as a nuclear chromatin-associated histone reader and transcriptional regulator.
Recognizes H3K4-methylated histone H3 and recruits DOT-1.1 histone methyltransferase to chromatin.
Forms a ZFP-1–DOT-1.1 complex; reported localization includes nucleus, chromosomes, and condensed chromosomes.

entities.name: DOT-1.1
observations: Histone methyltransferase partner recruited by C. elegans ZFP-1 to chromatin; associated with H3K79 methylation in the ZFP-1–DOT-1.1 complex.

entities.name: ZFP-1 sequence properties
observations: Query length is 768 aa; estimated molecular weight is 82,047.9 Da.
Theoretical pI is 8.56 and predicted charge at pH 7 is +10.1.
GRAVY is -0.366, consistent with a non-hydrophobic, soluble protein; instability index is 50.0.
The sequence contains extensive low-complexity, proline/serine-rich regions consistent with regulatory modification sites.
